grid.grayboxRule: All collision dimensions remain integer millimeters; author on the primary grid except documented fine-clearance tests.

timingModel.fromRestFormula: If d <= 675 mm, t=sqrt(2d/60000); otherwise t=150 ms + (d-675 mm)/9000 mm/s.
timingModel.rule: Geometry establishes only a calculation seed. Penalties are explicit per route and must be replaced by authoritative route tapes.
